alias_ambiguities.notes: Regional meanings outside the approved Mati commercial scope remain context-dependent. In Mati category ID11, decision 1 fixes POLERA to tshirt. No automatic historical relabeling or training truth follows.
Product name vs textile structure must use context; never resolve unscoped automatically.
Ambiguous broader/variant usage; not synonym normalization to tartan.

boundaries.business: IDs and commercial classification authoritative only in Laravel
boundaries.trend: Time-bounded observations external to permanent ontology

freeze_policy: Schema validation is necessary but insufficient; manual domain review required.

version_policy.patch: Clarification/alias only, no semantic change; alias conflict requires validation.
version_policy.minor: Backward-compatible optional concepts/attributes; retraining schema migration explicit.
version_policy.major: Meaning, applicability, removal, split/merge, ordinal ordering or label-domain change affecting existing assertions.
version_policy.id_policy: Stable semantic IDs independent of labels; deprecate with replacement mapping, never recycle.

identity_policy.commercial_authority: Laravel preserves IDs, categories, SKU, prices, variants and stock.
identity_policy.resolution: Evidence-backed identity or UNKNOWN with candidates, evidence and administrative discrepancy review; mappings are never automatic training labels.

local_aliases.scope: Mati commercial catalogue only; approved decision 1; not a universal regional alias.

identity_policy.commercial_set_policy: Routine sale is individual garments; authentic sets require explicit commercial association. Exact shared/reserved/packaged component inventory model is pending and unimplemented.
identity_policy.outfit_policy: Combination of independently sold products; does not create a commercial product, set, package price or inventory movement.
